info.name: TaskMaster API
info.description:
Comprehensive TaskMaster API collection with all endpoints, authentication, and testing scenarios.

## Setup Instructions

1. Import this collection into Postman
2. Set up environment variables:
   - `baseUrl`: API base URL (e.g., https://api.taskmaster.dev)
   - `apiKey`: Your API key (tk_live_...)
   - `sessionToken`: Session token (if using session auth)
3. Run the "Setup & Health Check" folder first
4. Explore different API features through organized folders

## Features Covered

- ✅ Authentication (API Key, Session)
- ✅ Tasks API v2 (CRUD, filtering, batch operations)
- ✅ Events API v2 (Calendar integration)
- ✅ Search API (Full-text search, faceting)
- ✅ Export API (CSV, JSON, PDF)
- ✅ WebSocket API (Real-time features)
- ✅ Analytics API (Usage monitoring)
- ✅ Webhooks API (Event-driven integrations)
- ✅ Error handling and edge cases

## Environment Variables

Required:
- `baseUrl` - API base URL
- `apiKey` - Your API key

Optional:
- `sessionToken` - Session authentication token
- `userId` - Your user ID
- `projectId` - Test project ID
- `initiativeId` - Test initiative ID
